name: DNS Tunneling — Abnormal Query Volume from Single Host
description: Detects abnormally high DNS query volume from a single source IP within a 5-minute window. DNS tunneling tools encode data within DNS queries and transmit them at high frequency to attacker-controlled resolvers. Unlike signature-based approaches that target known malicious domains, this rule detects the behavioural anomaly — making it effective even when attackers rotate infrastructure. Threshold of 50 queries per 5 minutes was chosen to exceed normal browsing behaviour while capturing tunneling activity. NXDOMAIN responses are expected and do not invalidate the detection.
author: Noel Biju John
